title: African American Mother and Child in Southern Yard, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing an African American woman and a toddler outside in a sun-dappled yard. The woman stands smiling near a rustic wooden trellis, dressed in a dark cardigan over a white dress, while the young child stands near the wall of the house in the foreground. Spanish moss hangs heavily from mature trees overhead, suggesting a rural or suburban setting in the American South during the 1950s.
